shortDescription: Manages BGP configuration on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: as_number
options.description: Local AS number. The value is a string of 1 to 11 characters.

options.name: as_path_limit
options.description: Maximum number of AS numbers in the AS_Path attribute. The default value is 255.

options.name: bgp_rid_auto_sel
options.description: The function to automatically select router IDs for all VPN BGP instances is enabled.

options.name: check_first_as
options.description: Check the first AS in the AS_Path of the update messages from EBGP peers.

options.name: clear_interval
options.description: Clear interval.

options.name: confed_id_number
options.description: Confederation ID. The value is a string of 1 to 11 characters.

options.name: confed_nonstanded
options.description: Configure the device to be compatible with devices in a nonstandard confederation.

options.name: confed_peer_as_num
options.description: Confederation AS number, in two-byte or four-byte format. The value is a string of 1 to 11 characters.

options.name: conn_retry_time
options.description: ConnectRetry interval. The value is an integer, in seconds. The default value is 32s.

options.name: default_af_type
options.description: Type of a created address family, which can be IPv4 unicast or IPv6 unicast. The default type is IPv4 unicast.

options.name: ebgp_if_sensitive
options.description: If the value is true, After the fast EBGP interface awareness function is enabled, EBGP sessions on an interface are deleted immediately when the interface goes Down. If the value is  false, After the fast EBGP interface awareness function is enabled, EBGP sessions on an interface are not deleted immediately when the interface goes Down.

options.name: gr_peer_reset
options.description: Peer disconnection through GR.

options.name: graceful_restart
options.description: Enable GR of the BGP speaker in the specified address family, peer address, or peer group.

options.name: hold_interval
options.description: Hold interval.

options.name: hold_time
options.description: Hold time, in seconds. The value of the hold time can be 0 or range from 3 to 65535.

options.name: is_shutdown
options.description: Interrupt BGP all neighbor.

options.name: keep_all_routes
options.description: If the value is true, the system stores all route update messages received from all peers (groups) after BGP connection setup. If the value is false, the system stores only BGP update messages that are received from peers and pass the configured import policy.

options.name: keepalive_time
options.description: If the value of a timer changes, the BGP peer relationship between the routers is disconnected. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 21845. The default value is 60.

options.name: memory_limit
options.description: Support BGP RIB memory protection.

options.name: min_hold_time
options.description: Min hold time, in seconds. The value of the hold time can be 0 or range from 20 to 65535.

options.name: router_id
options.description: ID of a router that is in IPv4 address format.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.

options.name: suppress_interval
options.description: Suppress interval.

options.name: time_wait_for_rib
options.description: Period of waiting for the End-Of-RIB flag. The value is an integer ranging from 3 to 3000. The default value is 600.

options.name: vrf_name
options.description: Name of a BGP instance. The name is a case-sensitive string of characters.

options.name: vrf_rid_auto_sel
options.description: If the value is true, VPN BGP instances are enabled to automatically select router IDs. If the value is false, VPN BGP instances are disabled from automatically selecting router IDs.
